title: Google Summer Software Engineering Internship
short_description: Work on real-world software projects alongside Google engineers with mentorship and hands-on coding experience.
description: The Google Software Engineering Internship is a 12-week program designed for students pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science or a related field. You will build core search, AI, and cloud infrastructure tools with guidance from senior mentors.
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in CS, Software Engineering, or related technical field. Expected graduation between Dec 2026 and June 2028.

title: Microsoft Engage Apprentice Program 2026
short_description: A mentorship-driven internship initiative where students build innovative projects using Azure AI services.
description: Microsoft Engage provides engineering students with direct access to Microsoft mentors, curated learning paths, and hands-on capstone project building. Exceptional performers receive direct full-time internship interviews.
eligibility: Students in 2nd or 3rd year of undergraduate studies in engineering or technology.

title: Amazon AWS Cloud Developer Intern
short_description: Build high-scale distributed backend microservices and cloud infrastructure powering AWS cloud platforms.
description: Join AWS software development teams to solve complex problems in cloud computing, serverless architectures, and global data storage.
eligibility: Enrolled in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field. Strong foundation in object-oriented programming.

title: Meta Frontend Engineering Fellow
short_description: Develop high-performance Web UI components for Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp web platforms.
description: Meta's Frontend Fellowship gives aspiring web developers the opportunity to write production React code, improve accessibility, and build social interactive components.
eligibility: Students with hands-on experience in JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and modern React frameworks.

title: IBM AI & Quantum Research Intern
short_description: Explore frontier machine learning architectures and Qiskit quantum algorithms under top research scientists.
description: IBM Research offers immersive internships in foundational AI, generative modeling, and quantum computing algorithm optimization.
eligibility: Students pursuing BS, MS, or PhD in CS, Physics, Math, or Data Science.

title: HackMIT 2026 Global Hackathon
short_description: One of the world's premier student hackathons bringing 1,000+ coders together for 36 hours of creation.
description: HackMIT is MIT's flagship undergraduate hackathon. Teams build software or hardware solutions from scratch, receive mentorship from top tech companies, and pitch to industry judges.
eligibility: Undergraduate students enrolled at any accredited university worldwide.

title: Smart India Hackathon 2026
organization: Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
short_description: Nationwide initiative to provide students a platform to solve real pressing challenges of government ministries & industries.
description: SIH is a grand digital product building competition. Student teams submit solutions for hardware and software problem statements posted by central ministries and corporate partners.
eligibility: Teams of 6 students from recognized technical colleges/universities across India.

title: MLH Global Hack Week: AI & ML Edition
short_description: A week-long beginner-friendly celebration of hacker culture featuring workshops, mini-events, and project building.
description: Global Hack Week is a 7-day virtual festival by Major League Hacking. Learn new tools, build AI projects, earn badges, and connect with hackers globally.
eligibility: Open to all students regardless of experience level.

title: ETHGlobal Web3 & Decentralized App Summit
short_description: Build decentralized applications, smart contracts, and Web3 user interfaces with expert mentors.
description: ETHGlobal brings together engineers, designers, and innovators to build the next generation of decentralized web technologies over an intense 3-day hackathon.
eligibility: Students and developers interested in blockchain technology and frontend engineering.

title: Hack The North 2026
short_description: Canada's largest hackathon where 3,000+ students build extraordinary projects with top-tier hardware and API support.
description: Hack the North provides travel reimbursements, world-class speaker sessions, and 36 hours of uninterrupted creative coding.
eligibility: Enrolled students from any high school or post-secondary institution.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2026 World Championship
short_description: The world's premier student technology competition empowering student founders to build purpose-driven AI startups.
description: Imagine Cup encourages students to build solutions for social, environmental, and accessibility impact using Azure Cloud and AI technologies.
eligibility: Students aged 18+ enrolled in accredited higher education institutions.

title: Kaggle Data Science & ML Grand Prix
short_description: Compete against student data scientists to build predictive ML algorithms for medical image diagnosis.
description: Train state-of-the-art PyTorch/TensorFlow models to analyze multi-modal clinical diagnostic datasets and present your solution notebook.
eligibility: Open to all Kaggle student accounts worldwide.

title: ICPC International Collegiate Programming Contest
short_description: The oldest and most prestigious algorithmic programming competition for university students.
description: Teams of 3 students solve 10-12 complex algorithmic problems under tight 5-hour time limits with a single computer.
eligibility: College students registered through their official university ICPC coach.

title: Women in Tech Global Leadership Scholarship
short_description: Financial award and career mentorship supporting women pursuing degrees in Computer Science & STEM fields.
description: Provides tuition assistance, access to technical leaders, and full sponsorship to attend the Grace Hopper Celebration conference.
eligibility: Female-identifying students enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program in computing or engineering.

title: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship 2026
stipend_or_prize: Up to ₹2,00,000 over duration of degree
short_description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for top undergraduate students studying STEM, CS, and Engineering disciplines in India.
description: Empowering meritous students with financial support, leadership development workshops, and networking opportunities.
eligibility: First-year undergraduate students with household income less than ₹15 Lakhs/year.

title: Google Generation Computer Science Scholarship
short_description: Awarded based on academic performance, passion for technology, and demonstrated leadership diversity.
description: Designed to help computer science students excel in technology and become future leaders in the industry.
eligibility: Students studying Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or closely related technical field.

title: Deep Learning Specialization by Andrew Ng
short_description: Master deep learning fundamentals, build neural networks in PyTorch & TensorFlow, and deploy AI models.
description: Learn foundational concepts of Neural Networks, CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, and LLMs from AI pioneer Andrew Ng.
eligibility: Basic Python proficiency and knowledge of high school algebra.

title: Harvard CS50: Web Programming with Python & JS
short_description: Dive deep into modern web development with Django, React, SQL databases, and user authentication.
description: This course picks up where CS50 left off, diving into design and implementation of web apps with Python, JavaScript, and Django.
eligibility: Prior programming experience equivalent to CS50x.

title: Full Stack Web Development & Cloud Systems Bootcamp
short_description: Build 10 real-world web apps from responsive landing pages to Node.js backend REST APIs.
description: Comprehensive project-based curriculum covering HTML5, CSS3 flexbox/grid, modern JavaScript ES6+, React, Node.js, and MongoDB.
eligibility: Open to absolute beginners and intermediate coding enthusiasts.

title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner Official Exam Voucher
short_description: Industry-recognized credential validating overall understanding of AWS cloud platform, security, and pricing.
description: Validate your cloud fluency and foundational AWS knowledge. Earn an official AWS digital badge for your LinkedIn and resume.
eligibility: High school or university students with basic IT/Cloud literacy.

title: Meta Front-End Developer Professional Certificate
short_description: Taught by Meta engineers to prepare you for an entry-level career as a front-end developer.
description: Includes 9 courses covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, UI/UX design in Figma, and a practical capstone project.
eligibility: No prior degree or experience required.

title: Hands-on Prompt Engineering & Generative AI Workshop
short_description: Interactive 3-hour weekend masterclass on building LLM agents, prompt chaining, and RAG pipelines.
description: Learn practical techniques for structured JSON prompting, function calling with GPT-4o, and integrating vector databases into web apps.
eligibility: Students with basic Python knowledge interested in generative AI.

title: Docker & Kubernetes Cloud Bootcamp Workshop
stipend_or_prize: Free Workshop + Swag + Exam Voucher (₹8,000 value)
short_description: Learn containerization basics, Dockerfile creation, and multi-container Kubernetes deployments in a hands-on lab.
description: An intensive weekend workshop designed to teach students modern cloud-native container orchestration tooling.
eligibility: Students familiar with Linux command line basics.
